summary: Putnam County, TN 80-ft steel tower dated circa 1944-1953; NHLR-registered 2022; now houses a Tennessee Forestry radio repeater; no access rule found.

events.note: NHLR: built circa 1944-1953 (Built field); the description says built between 1944 and 1953. Year 1944 is the start of that range, not a single build year
Listed as extant on the Tennessee Division of Forestry tower list dated March 26, 2014
Registered May 22, 2022 as US 1591, TN 40; nominated by Nicholas Kesterson

evidence.quote: This 80-foot steel tower was built between 1944 and 1953.

evidence.supports: tower now houses a radio repeater for the Tennessee Division of Forestry
evidence.quote: It currently houses a radio repeated for the Tennessee Division of Forestry.

corrections.why: The NHLR Built field reads circa 1944-1953 and the description says built between 1944 and 1953. The brief's 1944 is only the start of that range.

notes_for_editor: Brief correction: the build date is a range (circa 1944-1953), not a single year. No builder, tower model, staffing or fire history in any source read, and no access rule, so facts.access is omitted. Radio-repeater use comes from the NHLR description only. Sources: NHLR entry (registered 5/22/22), Tennessee Landforms table (GB2392 4-15 standing), and the MPS extant list (March 26, 2014). Used 2 WebSearch calls and about 3 page reads.
